chats.question: Which states had the worst late delivery rate last month?

answer.title: Highest late-delivery rates by state
answer.text: As of 22 Aug 2018, PI had the highest late-delivery rate in the selected period at 34.3%, followed by MA at 16.7% — both on small delivery counts — then BA and ES at 4.7% each. Most other states sit at or near zero.
answer.sql:
WITH delivered AS (
  SELECT c.customer_state AS state,
         CASE WHEN date(o.order_delivered_customer_date) > date(o.order_estimated_delivery_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS late
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
    AND date(o.order_delivered_customer_date) >= '2018-07-01'
    AND date(o.order_delivered_customer_date) < '2018-08-01'
    AND date(o.order_delivered_customer_date) < date(:as_of)
)
SELECT state,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(late) / COUNT(*), 1) AS late_pct,
       COUNT(*) AS deliveries
FROM delivered
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY late_pct DESC, deliveries DESC;

chats.question: Do late deliveries get worse reviews than on-time ones?

answer.title: Late deliveries score lower reviews
answer.text: As of 22 Aug 2018, among delivered orders with reviews, late deliveries averaged 2.25 versus 4.29 for on-time ones. Late orders were far fewer: 6,138 reviewed orders versus 86,018 on time.
answer.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN date(o.order_delivered_customer_date) <= date(o.order_estimated_delivery_date) THEN 'On time' ELSE 'Late' END AS delivery_status, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score, COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) AS reviewed_orders FROM orders o JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_delivered_customer_date < :as_of GROUP BY delivery_status ORDER BY delivery_status;

chats.question: Which product categories had the most late deliveries in the last 3 months?

answer.title: Most late deliveries by category
answer.text: As of 22 Aug 2018, among delivered orders in the last 3 months, Health beauty had the most late deliveries at 183, followed by Watches gifts at 90 and Housewares and Bed bath table at 71 each.
answer.sql: WITH late_deliveries AS (SELECT o.order_id, p.product_category_display AS category FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL AND date(o.order_delivered_customer_date) > date(o.order_estimated_delivery_date) AND date(o.order_delivered_customer_date) >= COALESCE(:window_start, date(:as_of, '-3 months')) AND date(o.order_delivered_customer_date) < :as_of AND p.product_category_display IS NOT NULL) SELECT category, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS late_deliveries FROM late_deliveries GROUP BY category ORDER BY late_deliveries DESC LIMIT 10;

chats.question: How many deliveries did we make each week over the last 3 months?

answer.title: Weekly deliveries, last 3 months
answer.text: As of 22 Aug 2018, weekly deliveries peaked at 2,021 in the week starting 13 Aug 2018. The first and last weeks in the window are partial, so their counts are lower.
answer.sql: WITH deliveries AS (SELECT order_id, date(order_delivered_customer_date) AS delivery_date FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND date(order_delivered_customer_date) < :as_of AND date(order_delivered_customer_date) >= COALESCE(:window_start, date(:as_of, '-3 months'))) SELECT date(delivery_date, 'weekday 0', '-6 days') AS week_start, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS deliveries FROM deliveries GROUP BY week_start ORDER BY week_start;
